title: Interaction Models
summary: This article from thinkingmachines.ai explores frameworks and methodologies for designing effective interactions between humans and AI systems, particularly focusing on patterns for conversational AI, agent-based interactions, and best practices for building intuitive human-AI workflows.
problem_solved: Helps developers and designers understand how to structure and optimize communication patterns between users and AI systems for better usability and effectiveness.
why_valuable: Provides practical guidance on designing interaction patterns that make AI systems more intuitive, efficient, and user-friendly in real-world applications.
